matte_paint_summer_maintenance.title: Matte paint summer maintenance
matte_paint_summer_maintenance.whyThisMatters: Summer heat and sun increase the risk of water spots, product drying on panels, and visible defects on sensitive finishes. This blueprint sequences trusted wash knowledge for safe maintenance.
matte_paint_summer_maintenance.maintenanceIntervalText: Maintenance wash every 2–4 weeks in summer, or sooner if the vehicle is exposed to insects, road film, or hard water.
bundleSuggestions: Meguiar's Gold Class Car Wash Shampoo and Conditioner

ceramic_coating_maintenance_wash.title: Ceramic coating maintenance wash
ceramic_coating_maintenance_wash.whyThisMatters: Coated paint needs pH-neutral maintenance and compatible wash chemistry to preserve hydrophobics between top-ups.
ceramic_coating_maintenance_wash.maintenanceIntervalText: Use a maintenance wash suitable for coatings every 2–3 weeks; adjust frequency by environment and water hardness.
bundleSuggestions: pH-neutral shampoo suitable for coated vehicles
Soft drying towel dedicated to coated finishes
